newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Suria, MBf seek nod for merger -source.
newsitem.headline: Suria, MBf seek nod for merger -source.

text.p: Malaysian financial groups Suria Capital Bhd and MBf Capital Bhd have submitted a proposal to Malaysian authorities to start negotiating a merger, an industry source told Reuters on Monday.

"The Ministry of Finance has confirmed that they have received the proposal for the negtiations to start," said the source close to the negotiations. The proposal has also been submitted to central Bank Negara, he said.
An approval from Bank Negara and the Ministry of Finance, mandatory under Malaysian law, to start the negotiations could be received as early as Monday afternoon, the source said.
The confirmation of the merger negotiations follow repeated denials from the two companies and heavy trading in their shares in the last two months.
The deal may involve the sale of a stake in Suria's wholly-owned subsidiary Sabah Bank Bhd, the source said.
MBf Capital shares were suspended from trading on Monday morning, but Suria's shares continued trading, rising 27 cents to 3.04 ringgit.
The source said trading in Suria shares could be suspended after the approval had been received from both Bank Negara and the Ministry of Finance.
